claims: Philadelphia is known as the "City of Brotherly Love".
Philadelphia is the sixth-most populous U.S. city.
Philadelphia is located in southeastern Pennsylvania.
Philadelphia has a population of over 1.5 million (2025 estimate).
Philadelphia is situated on the Delaware and Schuylkill rivers.
Philadelphia is the center of the Delaware Valley metropolitan area.
Philadelphia served as the nation's capital from 1790 to 1800.
Philadelphia is known for the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
Philadelphia is known for Independence National Historical Park.
Philadelphia will be a host city for the 2026 FIFA World Cup™.
The Philadelphia Visitor Center Corporation operates locations including LOVE Park and City Hall.
Local residents can access city services via Phila.gov.
